107.description: This vector represents Devanagari script characters and common Hindi text subwords.

8.description: This vector represents characters, subwords, and abbreviations commonly used in Hindi script and transliterated Hindi text processing.

33.description: This vector represents a noisy collection of multilingual alphanumeric characters and punctuation marks without a cohesive semantic theme.

169.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to characters and subwords from Indic scripts, particularly Devanagari.

177.description: This feature activates for rare subword tokens across various non-English scripts and specialized terms.

125.description: This vector activates for common Hindi suffixes and postpositions, particularly oblique case markers and verb endings involving the vowel 'ा' (aa).

49.description: This vector activates punctuation marks, symbols, and non-Latin character fragments acting as syntactic noise or sub-word artifacts.

131.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha) and its various conjunct forms combined with vowel matras and surrounding characters.

63.description: These tokens represent Hindi vowel sign diacritics combined with punctuation marks.

179.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi character n-grams and vowel combinations.
